stop_rule: Compute one exact bound for every fixed dyadic box on every qualified prior base; no changed interval method, conditioning cutoff, target or extra data after results.
coverage_scope: All fixed A-selected B0 interval means simultaneously before any B count gate; arbitrary overlap dependence; no conditioning on a successful B fit or cap. Ideal Poisson model, known density, fixed sample size regime; no optional stopping.
local_scope: Dyadic boxes with exponent >0 have no statistical coverage claim.
restricted_envelope_scope: Finite weight norm envelope only on assumed intrinsic design condition<=1e5. Does not certify the truth satisfies that gate.
